svg.title: Beam — searchlight robot
svg.desc: A plum robot whose head is a round searchlight in a slate yoke, with a thick rim, ringed pale glass and two eyes on a band across the lens, a sturdy boxy body with a power lever and vents, ring jointed arms with pincers, and legs with ring knees on flat feet.
